description: This loop walk takes you through Massey Woods near Dublin. In the woods you can follow a section of the Dublin Mountains Way along a pretty stream with lots of wildlife to look out for on the way. You can continue your walk in the adjacent Cruagh Woods Walk or by picking up the Montpelier Hill and Hellfire Forest Loop Walk .
